The function below is from the open-source project pallets/click, file src/click/shell_completion.py. It contains a bug that the maintainers later fixed. Write the fixed version of the whole function exactly as it appears in the project after the fix.

```python
    def get_completion_args(self) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
        cwords = split_arg_string(os.environ["COMP_WORDS"])
        incomplete = os.environ["COMP_CWORD"]
        args = cwords[1:]

        # Fish stores the partial word in both COMP_WORDS and
        # COMP_CWORD, remove it from complete args.
        if incomplete and args and args[-1] == incomplete:
            args.pop()

        return args, incomplete
```

{"fixed_function":"    def get_completion_args(self) -> tuple[list[str], str]:
        cwords = split_arg_string(os.environ["COMP_WORDS"])
        incomplete_index = int(os.environ["COMP_CWORD"])
        # The incomplete word is the one at the current cursor position.
        incomplete = cwords[incomplete_index] if incomplete_index < len(cwords) else ""
        # Arguments are everything after the command name up to the incomplete word.
        args = cwords[1:incomplete_index]

        # Fish stores the partial word in both COMP_WORDS and COMP_CWORD, remove it from complete args.
        if incomplete and args and args[-1] == incomplete:
            args.pop()

        return args, incomplete"}
